basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Transformation Engineer | Cross-Functional AI Adoption | LLM Ops & RAG | MBA
basics.summary: AI transformation practitioner who moves companies from AI curiosity to measurable adoption. At LumApps I own AI transformation end to end: identifying high-impact use cases with product and sales, prototyping fast, shipping to production, and reporting outcomes to C-level (2x conversions, $1M quarterly forecast). At Beekeeper I built and mentored the AI engineering cohort, replaced a $337K vendor with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks, and co-owned GTM adoption with Sales and Product. MBA-trained, comfortable translating LLMs into business value across technical and non-technical teams. Zurich-based, hybrid-ready.

work.name: LumApps
work.position: Lead AI Engineer & AI Transformation Lead
highlights: Own group-wide AI transformation end to end: run use-case discovery with Sales, Product, and RevOps; prioritize the roadmap; turn use cases into working prototypes and then production systems. Report adoption and outcomes directly to C-level.

Shipped a production multi-agent workflow for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph, Google ADK, with tools exposed over MCP and state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue. Prompt engineering, eval pipelines, and cost-per-request telemetry built in.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory for RAG. Grounds retrieval, cuts hallucinations, and enforces access control and data governance across the AI stack.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.position: Senior Software Engineer (Technical Lead, AI Adoption)
highlights: Replaced a $337K annual vendor translation contract with an in-house LLM pipeline (GitHub Actions + OpenAI APIs) shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated. Ran the adoption motion so the product team could iterate without external gatekeepers.
Built and mentored the AI engineering cohort as acting hiring manager. Hired for craft and curiosity, ran onboarding and hands-on training, grew engineers who now lead AI features independently.

Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis, GenAI Demo System). Each shipped with adoption metrics and impact reporting so we knew within a week if it moved the needle.

Built AI Onboarding Specialist: personalized, high-touch guidance for every new signup. 100% of customers guided through setup, time-to-first-value cut without adding headcount. Prompt engineering, eval loops, and responsible-use guardrails.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions. Same lens I bring to internal AI use-case scoring.
Advised portfolio companies on AI strategy, adoption, and building engineering cultures that ship.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off. Shipped the full autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries.
Built cloud infra and CI/CD on AWS. Enterprise reliability that enabled a Unilever partnership and a CES Las Vegas showcase.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: AI Transformation Engineer at Luware (Zurich-West, hybrid). Group-wide AI transformation initiative, Customer Zero for Microsoft. Identify and implement high-impact AI use cases across departments, turn roadmap into prototypes then production, deliver onboarding/workshops/training, track adoption metrics and impact, drive cultural shift toward AI adoption, ensure responsible AI aligned with policy/security/compliance. Wants: Wirtschaftsinformatik + tech background; proven digital transformation or AI adoption experience across departments (mandatory); Microsoft 365, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Power Platform; LLM integration, agent frameworks, MCP; AI governance, responsible AI; stakeholder management; translate AI to business value; full ML lifecycle; prompt engineering + fine-tuning; RAG, vector DBs, semantic search, bias mitigation.
_jobApplication.notes: Microsoft/Azure stack experience is lighter than the JD asks; leaned into transformation, adoption, MCP, RAG, prompt engineering, and cross-functional GTM strengths without overclaiming Copilot Studio / Power Platform.
